title: It's OK, plan on possibly having to repair.
text: It's OK, plan on possibly having to repair.. I put the frame on the wall using the provided hangers. I came home to find the frame on the floor in pieces. The frame came apart at one of the assembly joints. I used super glue to repair. So far it's holding. Assembly is somewhat weak and prone to failure. No, I did not contact the vendor.

product_metadata.title: ThisWear Family Tree Frame Fun Times & Memories Chalkboard Picture Frame Black Wood 6-Panel 4x6 Photo Frame
features: A great Fathers Day gift or Mothers Day gift for to share and remember great memories.
Includes three interchangable 4x6 inch chalkboard inserts and three 4x6 inch glass fronts to protect your photos. You choose which three landscape or portrait photos to use.
Use the included chalk to write a special message to the recipient -- just be sure to peel the protective film off of the chalkboard inserts when inserting your own pictures.
Physical frame dimensions measure approximately 20 inches wide by 12.5 inches tall and 1 inch deep.
The included sawtooth hanger and screws allow for easy installation and hanging of the frame.
